alert_reason: Leadership has compressed into a three-way race and Artificial Inu (AI) has become a material challenger, while the prior PONS confirmation spike has partially retraced. The ecosystem regime itself remains unusually strong relative to major peers.

ecosystem_evidence.interpretation: Turnover, fees, stablecoin base and cross-chain transfer activity remain elevated, but negative net inflows show that capital velocity/recycling is still a large part of the regime rather than simple one-way deposit growth.

PONS.note: Still backed by launchpad economics; Pons protocol fees are approximately $4.73M/24h. Price is only modestly above the frozen $0.405417 paper fill after having previously crossed the +10% confirmation level.

security.reason: Independent scanners disagree materially on overall safety/quality and historical Go+ concern has not been conclusively reconciled. Do not qualify for paper execution yet.

AI.narrative: AI is paired directly with Robinhood's tokenized NVDA and converts speculative meme activity into stock-token trading/liquidity, making it highly native to Robinhood Chain's differentiated product narrative.

CASHCAT.note: CASHCAT has materially re-strengthened and has the broadest holder base of the three, but its economic link to launchpad/stock-token activity is weaker than PONS or AI.

Sonic.reason: Positive percentage acceleration is from a very small base and appears tied to the Bundle Transactions upgrade; current DEX volume remains under ~$1M in another live tracker and does not yet show broad discretionary speculative migration.

forward_test_implication: Do not alter the PONS frozen rules. Record that the initial +10% confirmation was not persistent: PONS retraced toward the original simulated fill while AI and CASHCAT strengthened. This is evidence that leadership rotation may matter more than static first-leader selection.
